---
title: GetRigFromChar
description: Character-to-rig conversion utility that extracts essential rig components from a character model.
---

Extracts the rig components (HumanoidRootPart, Humanoid, Animator) from a Roblox character model into a typed structure for easier access.

## Usage

```luau
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local getRig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.GetRigFromChar)

local rig = getRig(character)
if rig then
    print('Root part:', rig.root)
    print('Humanoid:', rig.hum)
    print('Animator:', rig.animator)
end
```

## API Reference

### `getRig(char: Model): Rig?`

Extracts rig components from a character model.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `char` | `Model` | The character model to extract rig from |

Returns a `Rig` table if successful, `nil` if the character lacks required components.

## Rig Type

```luau
export type Rig = {
    char: Model & {
        HumanoidRootPart: Part,
        Humanoid: Humanoid & {
            Animator: Animator,
        },
        Head: Part,
        LeftHand: Part,
        RightHand: Part,
        LeftFoot: Part,
        RightFoot: Part,
        LeftUpperArm: Part,
        RightUpperArm: Part,
        LeftLowerArm: Part,
        RightLowerArm: Part,
        LeftUpperLeg: Part,
        RightUpperLeg: Part,
        LeftLowerLeg: Part,
        RightLowerLeg: Part,
    },
    root: Part,
    hum: Humanoid,
    animator: Animator,
}
```

## Example

```luau
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local getRig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.GetRigFromChar)

local function onCharacterAdded(char: Model)
    local rig = getRig(char)
    if not rig then return end

    -- Access rig components directly
    rig.hum.WalkSpeed = 16
    rig.hum.JumpPower = 50

    -- Play an animation
    local track = rig.animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
    track:Play()
end

Players.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)
```
